name: foot
summary: Fast, lightweight Wayland-only terminal with sixel, fontconfig fallback, server mode and an INI config. No tabs, splits, ligatures or background images.

install.notes: Distro package name; not confirmed from the official pages (Codeberg blocked automated fetches), the Arch man pages were used.
Debian/Ubuntu; may lag the latest release (1.28.0 at verification). Unverified here.

linux.notes: Wayland compositors only; no X11. --check-config exits 0 when valid and 230 when not. An example foot.ini with every default commented out is usually installed at /etc/xdg/foot/foot.ini. Config is read at start; there is no live reload. Sections [colors-dark]/[colors-light] need foot 1.26+; [colors] and [colors2] were removed in 1.28.0.

ligatures.notes: The foot.ini(5) man page read has no ligature option (only `grapheme-shaping` under [tweak], for grapheme clusters). Foot is widely documented as not supporting ligatures, but that statement was not found in the pages fetched. Use kitty, Ghostty or iTerm2 for ligatures.

blur.notes: 1.26.0+, needs a build against wayland-protocols 1.45+ and a compositor with ext-background-effect-v1.

background-image.notes: Not available; the config reference has no image option. Use alpha with a compositor-drawn wallpaper, or kitty/Ghostty/iTerm2 for images.

background-animated.notes: No images or shaders. Use kitty (custom_shaders) or Ghostty (custom-shader).

shader.notes: No shader support. Use Ghostty or kitty.

tabs.notes: No tabs. Use tmux/zellij, or one window per task under a tiling compositor.

splits.notes: No built-in splits. Use tmux/zellij or compositor tiling.

quake.notes: No drop-down mode. Set `app-id` and use a compositor scratchpad or window rule (compositor-specific, unverified), or use kitty's quick-access-terminal.

startup-layout.notes: No sessions or layouts. Start a multiplexer layout with `shell=`/command, or set `initial-window-size-chars`.

inline-images.notes: Sixel. The kitty and iTerm2 image protocols are not documented.

profiles.notes: No profiles. Use `foot -c <file>`, `include=` in foot.ini, or `-o section.key=value` per launch.

config-reload.notes: No live reload; restart foot (in server mode restart the server). Runtime color theme switching works: key bindings color-theme-switch-dark / color-theme-switch-light / color-theme-toggle, or SIGUSR1/SIGUSR2 to the foot process.
